quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ

parent_channels.name: Directed Awareness and Cognitive Response

subchannels.name: Seeing, Gaze, and Occlusion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A viewer directs sight or reflection toward an object while blindness, distance, or concealment can block access.
subchannels.active_motifs: directed seeing and reflection `ن ظ ر:B001/m01`; intense gaze `ح د ق:B004/m01`; sensory detection `ء ن س:B002/m01`; bodily blindness `ع م ي:B001/m01`; blindness of the heart `ع م ي:B002/m01`; far sight `ش ي ء:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Directed sight, inward reflection, and long-range seeing form one access scene whose negative forms are physical blindness and the heart's inability to apprehend.

subchannels.name: Listening and Acoustic Impact
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sound is produced, propagated, and received with effects ranging from recognition to overwhelming impact.
subchannels.active_motifs: intentional listening `ش ي ء:B005/m01`; deafening cry `ص خ خ:B001/m01`; reverberating echo `ص د ي:B004/m01`; raised voice `ر ف ع:B010/m01`; loud speech or noise `ب ر ر:B004/m01`; sensory detection by sound `ء ن س:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Listening occupies the receptive end of a scene that includes loud utterance, echo, and the cry whose intensity defeats ordinary hearing.

subchannels.name: Recollection, Reminder, and Forgetting
subchannels.scene_or_process: A remembered matter is called back, voiced as a reminder, or lost through forgetting and neglect.
subchannels.active_motifs: inward recollection `ذ ك ر:B003/m01`; spoken mention `ذ ك ر:B004/m01`; reminder `ذ ك ر:B009/m01`; forgetting `ء م ه:B001/m01`; deliberate neglect `ش ء ن:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Memory becomes a communicative process: an absent matter is recovered, mentioned, and made useful as reminder, while forgetting and disregard interrupt the sequence.

subchannels.name: Distraction and Cognitive Dimming
subchannels.scene_or_process: Attention turns away until awareness is dulled, obscured, or suspended.
subchannels.active_motifs: diversion from a concern `ل ه و:B001/m01`; heedless preoccupation `ل ه ي:B001/m01`; a deadened heart `م و ت:B006/m01`; a water-like dull heart `م و ه:B008/m01`; involuntary derangement `ء ر ض:B012/m01`; fainting or madness `م و ت:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Ordinary distraction grades into figurative cardiac dullness and finally into states where cognition or voluntary control is suspended.

subchannels.name: Watchfulness and Deliberation
subchannels.scene_or_process: An observer watches, compares alternatives, and forms a plan before acting.
subchannels.active_motifs: vigilant custodian `ن ظ ر:B009/m01`; mutual deliberation `ن ظ ر:B010/m01`; counsel over an affair `ء م ر:B007/m01`; calculation and planning `ق د ر:B005/m01`; estimation before action `خ ل ق:B001/m01`; selective choosing `ن خ ل:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Watching is not passive: it supports comparison, counsel, prior estimation, selection, and the conversion of alternatives into an intended plan.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A subject opens, directs, withholds, or loses perceptual and cognitive access to an object.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 80:1-12 turns on attention, blindness, fear, reminder, and distraction, while 80:24 commands reflective looking.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same system extends from eyes and ears into sentinels, debate, impaired hearts, and total self-surrender.

parent_channels.name: Intention, Motion, and Encounter

subchannels.name: Aim, Choice, and Destination
subchannels.scene_or_process: An agent singles out a goal and directs readiness or movement toward it.
subchannels.active_motifs: aiming and readiness `ء ب ب:B002/m01`; intentional selection `ء خ و:B003/m01`; directed aim `ء م م:B012/m01`; targeting a raid `د ر ي:B002/m01`; intended concern `ش ء ن:B002/m01`; choosing by sifting `ن خ ل:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Readiness, selection, targeting, and concern are successive aspects of one directed act: choosing what matters and orienting action toward it.

subchannels.name: Road, Travel, and the Wayfarer
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler enters a marked way, traverses distance, and may continue without pause.
subchannels.active_motifs: road or course `س ب ل:B001/m01`; wayfarer `س ب ل:B002/m01`; travel `س ف ر:B003/m01`; ascent or onward travel `ر ف ع:B011/m01`; uninterrupted travel `ص ب ب:B010/m01`; remote distance `ش ق ق:B005/m01`; branching minor roads `ب ن ي:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The route scene joins the traversable way, its traveler, its branching tracks, distance, ascent, and sustained movement.

subchannels.name: Coming, Bringing, and Presentation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or thing arrives, is brought forward, or is formally presented to an authority.
subchannels.active_motifs: coming or arrival `ج ي ء:B001/m01`; bringing or presenting `ج ي ء:B004/m01`; formal presentation to authority `ر ف ع:B004/m01`; confronting face-to-face `و ج ه:B003/m01`; exposing oneself before another `ء ر ض:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Ordinary arrival develops into causative bringing and formal presentation, with confrontation and exposure marking the endpoint of approach.

subchannels.name: Nearness, Facing, and Accompaniment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Participants enter proximity, turn toward one another, and establish accompaniment or association.
subchannels.active_motifs: immediate proximity `و ل ي:B001/m01`; turning the face or senses toward something `و ل ي:B006/m01`; frontal nearness `ء م م:B011/m01`; catching up and drawing near `ر ه ق:B002/m01`; accompaniment `ء ل ي:B003/m01`; companionship `ص ح ب:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Spatial nearness becomes relational: catching up, facing, accompanying, and remaining with another all reduce the interval between participants.

subchannels.name: Flight, Pursuit, and Competitive Motion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Urgent movement separates participants through flight, pursuit, racing, or dispersal.
subchannels.active_motifs: flight from another `ف ر ر:B001/m01`; racing and overcoming `س ع ي:B008/m01`; rout by a charge `ء ب ب:B007/m01`; rapid agile gait `ي س ر:B005/m01`; collective dispersal `ن ع م:B008/m01`; dominance through repeated coming `ج ي ء:B001/m02`.
subchannels.synthesis: Flight and dispersal pull bodies apart, while pursuit, racing, and repeated arrival reverse the relation by closing distance and establishing superiority.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A participant selects a goal, follows a course, and changes relation to others through approach, arrival, pursuit, or withdrawal.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 80:1-10 stages turning away, coming, striving, and attentive approach, while 80:20 gives the facilitated path and 80:34 the act of flight.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Paths become offspring-like branches, repeated arrival becomes dominance, and bodily facing becomes social alignment.

parent_channels.name: Measure, Capacity, Order, and Control

subchannels.name: Estimation, Proportion, and Fit
subchannels.scene_or_process: An intended result is measured in advance and its parts are fitted to a suitable proportion.
subchannels.active_motifs: measure and limit `ق د ر:B001/m01`; planning by calculation `ق د ر:B005/m01`; proportion and fit `ق د ر:B006/m01`; pre-action estimation `خ ل ق:B001/m01`; judgment of value `ط ع م:B008/m01`; aptitude or suitability `خ ل ق:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Estimation supplies limits, proportion fits components, aptitude tests the recipient, and valuation determines whether the projected arrangement is appropriate.

subchannels.name: Ability, Ease, and Effort
subchannels.scene_or_process: An agent's capacity meets a task that may be facilitated, resisted, or completed through exertion.
subchannels.active_motifs: power or possession `ق د ر:B003/m01`; ability `ء ل ي:B011/m01`; ability to perform `ط ع م:B011/m01`; ease after difficulty `ي س ر:B001/m01`; suitability `ء ر ض:B003/m01`; exertion `ء ل ي:B010/m01`; hardship `ش ق ق:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Capability is relational rather than absolute: a task must suit the agent, become accessible, and still receive the effort needed to overcome hardship.

subchannels.name: Parts, Counterparts, and Succession
subchannels.scene_or_process: Units are paired, divided, matched, or arranged one after another.
subchannels.active_motifs: even pair `ز ك و:B005/m01`; half or side `ش ق ق:B002/m01`; totality or whole `ك ل ل:B003/m01`; matching counterpart `ن ظ ر:B006/m01`; uninterrupted succession `و ل ي:B002/m01`; sequential formation `ط ع م:B014/m01`; what lies before `ي د ي:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Pair, half, whole, equivalent, predecessor, and successor form a relational calculus for locating each unit within a structured series.

subchannels.name: Command, Governance, and Judgment
subchannels.scene_or_process: An authority formulates an order, administers an affair, and renders a binding decision.
subchannels.active_motifs: command or obligation `ء م ر:B002/m01`; governance `ء م ر:B003/m01`; administrative charge `س ع ي:B003/m01`; entrusted rule `و ل ي:B003/m01`; judgment `ق ض ي:B001/m01`; sovereign hand `ي د ي:B005/m01`; presentation to authority `ر ف ع:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Governance links deliberated command, delegated administration, formal presentation, and judgment under the effective hand of authority.

subchannels.name: Coercion, Submission, and Bound Labor
subchannels.scene_or_process: Force constrains another's will, producing obedience, bondage, labor, or eventual release.
subchannels.active_motifs: compulsion `ج ي ء:B005/m01`; coercion into disobedience `ك ف ر:B007/m01`; submissive giving of the hand `ي د ي:B006/m01`; obedience `ص ح ب:B003/m01`; bodily gesture of submission `ك ف ر:B014/m01`; fetter `ص ب ب:B009/m01`; labor toward manumission `س ع ي:B005/m01`; forced prostitution of bondmaids `س ع ي:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Constraint ranges from compelled conduct and symbolic submission to literal fettering and exploitative labor, with manumission providing the scene's release outcome.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Possibilities are bounded, compared, ordered, authorized, and converted into executable action.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 80:19 presents determination and proportion, 80:20 facilitation, 80:23 an unfulfilled command, and 80:37 an all-absorbing affair.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Abstract control is repeatedly embodied in the hand, fitted equipment, bonds, and orderly succession.

parent_channels.name: Human Formation, Character, and Life Cycle

subchannels.name: Creation and Bodily Constitution
subchannels.scene_or_process: A human entity is brought into being and given an organized bodily form.
subchannels.active_motifs: origination `خ ل ق:B002/m01`; well-proportioned form `خ ل ق:B003/m01`; bodily constitution `ب ن ي:B002/m01`; stature and form `ء م م:B006/m01`; human person `م ر ء:B001/m01`; mankind `ب ش ر:B002/m01`; humanity `ء ن س:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Creation is rendered as organized construction: humanity receives stature, proportion, bodily constitution, and the status of an individuated person.

subchannels.name: Character, Virtue, and Disfigurement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Outer form and inner disposition are evaluated as sound, virtuous, distorted, or defective.
subchannels.active_motifs: moral character `خ ل ق:B004/m01`; complete outer and inner virtue `ب ش ر:B008/m01`; acceptable personhood `م ر ء:B006/m01`; bodily or moral disfigurement `ش ي ء:B002/m01`; human defect `ء م م:B015/m01`; forged characterization `خ ل ق:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The human form becomes an ethical surface: constitution and character can be completed, accepted, falsified in description, or marred.

subchannels.name: Reproduction, Sex, and Birth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sexual union and generative fluid lead to gendered embodiment and birth.
subchannels.active_motifs: seminal fluid `ن ط ف:B002/m03`; semen as water `م و ه:B004/m01`; male sex `ذ ك ر:B001/m01`; phallus `ق ض ب:B009/m01`; consummated union `ب ن ي:B006/m01`; marriage `غ ن ي:B006/m01`; hands-first birth `و ج ه:B010/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The lexical scene joins generative fluid, male anatomy, union, marriage, and the physical manner of emergence at birth.

subchannels.name: Upbringing, Youth, Adulthood, and Aging
subchannels.scene_or_process: A dependent human is raised, grows into companionship, and eventually enters decline.
subchannels.active_motifs: human upbringing as cultivation `ن ب ت:B006/m01`; youth and demographic growth `ن ب ت:B003/m01`; fatherly nurture `ء ب و:B001/m01`; adult child becoming a companion `ص ح ب:B005/m01`; aging and decline `و ج ه:B009/m01`; bereaved parent `م و ت:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Cultivation supplies the governing analogy for nurture and youth; maturity changes child into companion, while aging and bereavement expose the fragility of the family line.

subchannels.name: Death, Burial, and Revival
subchannels.scene_or_process: Life ends, the body is placed in the grave, and revivification remains possible.
subchannels.active_motifs: death `م و ت:B001/m01`; judicial or appointed death `ق ض ي:B003/m01`; burial `ق ب ر:B001/m01`; killing `ق ت ل:B001/m01`; bodily weakening toward death `م و ت:B002/m01`; revivification `ن ش ر:B002/m01`; carrion `م و ت:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Killing or weakening terminates embodied life, burial encloses the remains, and revival reverses the closure by restoring animation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Human existence is shaped from origin through bodily formation, social maturation, decline, death, and renewed life.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 80:17-23 explicitly sequences humanity, creation, determination, the path, death, burial, and possible resurrection.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Biological formation extends into character, social acceptability, marriage, bereavement, and the built constitution of the body.

parent_channels.name: Kinship, Community, and Social Continuity

subchannels.name: Parent, Mother, and Origin
subchannels.scene_or_process: A parent nurtures a descendant and also serves as a figure for source, center, and origin.
subchannels.active_motifs: fatherhood and nurture `ء ب و:B001/m01`; mother `ء م م:B001/m01`; mother `ء م ه:B004/m01`; source and central origin `ء م م:B002/m01`; origin of growth `ن ب ت:B005/m01`; filial vocative `ء ب و:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Literal parenthood and the wider source relation share a generative center from which persons, growth, and collective identity proceed.

subchannels.name: Children, Descent, and Clan
subchannels.scene_or_process: Descendants extend a line that becomes a named household, lineage, or clan.
subchannels.active_motifs: children and lineage `ب ن ي:B007/m01`; clan name `ن ب ت:B004/m01`; tribal name `ع ب س:B005/m01`; clan affiliation `ف ر ر:B014/m01`; collateral kin and inheritance `ك ل ل:B004/m01`; offspring-like branch roads `ب ن ي:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Descent expands from children into collateral relatives and named clans, while branching roads preserve the same source-to-offshoot geometry.

subchannels.name: Sibling, Companion, and Intimate
subchannels.scene_or_process: Social nearness is formed through siblinghood, familiarity, companionship, and affection.
subchannels.active_motifs: sibling and close friend `ء خ و:B001/m01`; companionship `ص ح ب:B001/m01`; familiarity `ء ن س:B003/m01`; favored intimate `ء ن س:B006/m01`; love `ح ب ب:B002/m01`; affectionate alliance `و ل ي:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Blood siblinghood and chosen intimacy converge in a relation of familiarity, affection, accompaniment, and mutual support.

subchannels.name: Care, Protection, and Guardianship
subchannels.scene_or_process: A stronger party assumes responsibility for a dependent, relative, neighbor, or client.
subchannels.active_motifs: care for kin `ب ر ر:B003/m01`; protective companionship `ص ح ب:B002/m01`; guardianship and wardship `و ل ي:B003/m01`; aid and defense `ي د ي:B016/m01`; clientage and legal kinship `و ل ي:B005/m01`; dependent burden `ك ل ل:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Care binds protector and dependent through companionship, guardianship, defense, clientage, and the practical burden of support.

subchannels.name: Community, Tradition, and Leadership
subchannels.scene_or_process: Individuals gather into a people whose inherited way is embodied and directed by an exemplar.
subchannels.active_motifs: community or species `ء م م:B004/m01`; religion or inherited tradition `ء م م:B005/m01`; leader and exemplar `ء م م:B009/m01`; natural or unlettered condition `ء م م:B007/m01`; collective mixing `ف ر ر:B016/m01`; clustered groups `ك ل ل:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Community is a collected human body with a received tradition, a guiding exemplar, and degrees of mixture or subgrouping.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Persons acquire identity, obligation, and support through descent, companionship, guardianship, and inherited collective forms.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 80:34-37 enumerates brother, mother, father, spouse, children, and the isolating affair of each person.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Kinship patterns recur in plant offshoots, branch roads, clientage, religious tradition, and political leadership.

parent_channels.name: Land, Water, and Vegetative Renewal

subchannels.name: Earth, Soil, and Pasture
subchannels.scene_or_process: Land provides a low, receptive, and fertile substrate in which growth can remain rooted.
subchannels.active_motifs: fertile soft earth `ء ر ض:B002/m01`; low ground `ء ر ض:B001/m01`; remaining attached to the ground `ء ر ض:B006/m01`; fertile soil and rain `ك ر م:B002/m01`; open land or desert `ب ر ر:B005/m01`; pasture `ء ب ب:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Low and fertile ground receives growth, supports pasture, and holds organisms in place, joining terrain and productivity in one substrate scene.

subchannels.name: Pouring, Dripping, and Collection
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water descends, runs, ripples, and collects in hollows or vessels.
subchannels.active_motifs: water `م و ه:B001/m01`; abundance of water `م و ه:B002/m01`; pouring `ص ب ب:B001/m01`; dripping and prolonged wetness `ن ط ف:B003/m01`; bubbles and ripples `ح ب ب:B008/m01`; basin or depression `ج ي ء:B002/m01`; water-holding hollow `خ ل ق:B011/m01`; shallow pool `ص ح ف:B004/m02`.
subchannels.synthesis: Falling and running water is tracked through droplets, surface motion, and eventual containment in basin, pool, or excavated hollow.

subchannels.name: Rain, Irrigation, and Revival
subchannels.scene_or_process: Precipitation reaches the land, irrigation distributes it, and dormant vegetation revives.
subchannels.active_motifs: rain `س ب ل:B005/m01`; later seasonal rain `و ل ي:B010/m01`; snow or rain `ن خ ل:B004/m01`; irrigation `م و ه:B003/m01`; rain reviving herbage `ن ش ر:B004/m01`; fissure with gushing water `ف ج ر:B001/m01`; earth splitting open `ش ق ق:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Rain and irrigation supply water, fissures admit or release it, and vegetal revival displays the productive outcome.

subchannels.name: Seed, Germination, and Herbage
subchannels.scene_or_process: Seed is covered, planted, and brought through the earth as grain, herbage, and fodder.
subchannels.active_motifs: grain or seed `ح ب ب:B001/m01`; plant growth `ن ب ت:B001/m01`; planting `ن ب ت:B002/m01`; increase and growth `ز ك و:B001/m01`; farmer covering seed `ك ف ر:B008/m01`; grain spike `س ب ل:B008/m01`; fresh fodder `ق ض ب:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The seed is hidden, planted, increased, and differentiated into spike and fodder, forming a complete cultivation process.

subchannels.name: Palm, Vine, Grove, and Garden
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cultivated trees gather into productive, bounded plantings.
subchannels.active_motifs: palm tree `ن خ ل:B001/m01`; vine `ك ر م:B004/m01`; olive tree `ز ي ت:B002/m01`; enclosed garden `ح د ق:B003/m01`; small palm `ش ي ء:B006/m01`; tall dry palm `ص د ي:B009/m01`; opening palm spathe `ض ح ك:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Individual palm, vine, and olive are joined by enclosure into the garden, with sapling, mature trunk, and opening spathe marking stages of arboreal life.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Terrain receives water, opens, and becomes a productive field of germination, growth, and enclosure.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 80:24-32 traces food through poured water, split earth, grain, grapes, fodder, olives, palms, gardens, fruit, pasture, and animal provision.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The ecological cycle reaches basins, wells, bubbles, dripping surfaces, snowfall, sifting, and offspring-like saplings.

parent_channels.name: Harvest, Food, Hospitality, and Husbandry

subchannels.name: Reaping, Sifting, and Milling
subchannels.scene_or_process: Mature crop is lifted, cut, separated, and processed into usable grain.
subchannels.active_motifs: carrying the harvest `ر ف ع:B006/m01`; wheat `ب ر ر:B006/m01`; cutting crop `ق ض ب:B001/m01`; sword or sickle as cutter `ق ض ب:B005/m01`; sifting `ن خ ل:B002/m01`; grain entering a mill `ل ه و:B003/m01`; spike of grain `س ب ل:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Harvested stalks pass through lifting, cutting, sifting, and milling until the grain is separated from its coverings and ready for use.

subchannels.name: Fruit, Ripening, and Oil
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fruit develops on tree or vine, ripens, and is eaten or pressed into oil.
subchannels.active_motifs: grapes `ع ن ب:B001/m01`; fruit `ف ك ه:B002/m01`; olive `ز ي ت:B002/m01`; oil extraction `ز ي ت:B001/m01`; fruit becoming ripe `ط ع م:B005/m01`; fruit covering `ك ف ر:B010/m01`; jujube fruit `ع ن ب:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The fruit scene follows protected growth through ripening and consumption, with the olive adding extraction as a second path from fruit to provision.

subchannels.name: Eating, Digestion, and Nourished Flesh
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food is tasted, swallowed, digested, and incorporated into the body.
subchannels.active_motifs: eating and tasting `ط ع م:B001/m01`; feeding another `ط ع م:B002/m01`; digestibility `م ر ء:B003/m01`; esophagus `م ر ء:B005/m01`; food building flesh `ب ن ي:B010/m01`; fullness from drinking `ح ب ب:B006/m01`; surfeit `ن ط ف:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Food moves from taste and feeding through the throat and digestion to bodily incorporation, with fullness and surfeit marking the limit of intake.

subchannels.name: Host, Guest, and Shared Provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: A host receives others, apportions food, and converts stored goods into hospitality.
subchannels.active_motifs: hospitality and income `ط ع م:B004/m01`; ceremonial eating `م ر ء:B004/m01`; crowding by guests or petitioners `ر ه ق:B006/m01`; commodity or provision `م ت ع:B003/m01`; favorable provision `ن ع م:B001/m01`; reciprocal gift `ك ر م:B008/m01`; food platter `ص ح ف:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Hospitality joins the arriving crowd, stored provision, serving vessel, ceremonial consumption, and the reciprocal social obligation created by a meal.

subchannels.name: Flock, Milk, Grazing, and Weaning
subchannels.scene_or_process: Herded animals graze, yield milk, reproduce, and are separated from their young under human care.
subchannels.active_motifs: livestock wealth `ن ع م:B005/m01`; pasture `ء ب ب:B001/m01`; retaining milk in the udder `ر ف ع:B007/m01`; abundant milk and offspring `ي س ر:B006/m01`; prebirth milk `ف ك ه:B004/m01`; night grazing `ن ش ر:B006/m01`; livestock caretaker `ص د ي:B005/m01`; weaning young animals `و ل ي:B015/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Pasture supports the flock, the caretaker regulates grazing and milk, and weaning converts reproductive abundance into an ordered husbandry cycle.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Productive land is converted into food, bodily nourishment, shared provision, and sustained animal wealth.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 80:24-32 moves from human food through crops and fruit to pasture and livestock provision.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The scene includes cutting tools, sieves, mills, cookware, ceremonial eating, digestion, udder retention, and weaning.

parent_channels.name: Blessing, Wealth, and Social Worth

subchannels.name: Blessing, Gift, and Benefit
subchannels.scene_or_process: A favorable good is bestowed, received, and made useful to another.
subchannels.active_motifs: blessings `ء ل ي:B006/m01`; gift `ء ل ي:B012/m01`; favorable state and benefaction `ن ع م:B001/m01`; bestowed hand or favor `ي د ي:B003/m01`; conferral of good or harm `و ل ي:B013/m01`; benefit `ن ف ع:B001/m01`; gift of oil `ز ي ت:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Blessing becomes socially effective when a giver places a usable good in another's hand and the recipient derives benefit from it.

subchannels.name: Sufficiency, Wealth, and Utility
subchannels.scene_or_process: Resources relieve need, sustain residence, and provide durable utility or enjoyment.
subchannels.active_motifs: wealth and needlessness `غ ن ي:B001/m01`; sufficiency `غ ن ي:B002/m01`; ease and affluence `ي س ر:B003/m01`; utility and enjoyment `م ت ع:B001/m01`; commodity and equipment `م ت ع:B003/m01`; prosperity and increase `ء م ر:B004/m01`; useful quality or strength `م ت ع:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Wealth is defined functionally as the capacity of goods, income, and productive increase to remove need and sustain life.

subchannels.name: Honor, Rank, and Reputation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person is elevated, publicly remembered, and recognized among the leading members of a group.
subchannels.active_motifs: honor and generosity `ك ر م:B001/m01`; elevated rank `ر ف ع:B002/m01`; reputation `ذ ك ر:B007/m01`; social standing `و ج ه:B006/m01`; elite status `ف ر ر:B008/m01`; precious person `ك ر م:B010/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Elevation and public mention create rank, while the face of a group and its elite embody collective recognition.

subchannels.name: Generosity and Reciprocity

subchannels.synthesis: Diversion begins as displaced attention, becomes active neglect, and culminates in withdrawal, postponement, or abandonment.

subchannels.name: Wit, Laughter, and Mockery
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech produces amusement that may remain convivial or turn against a target.
subchannels.active_motifs: witty talk `ف ك ه:B003/m01`; backbiting `ف ك ه:B007/m01`; laughter `ض ح ك:B001/m01`; making another a laughingstock `ض ح ك:B002/m01`; delight and wonder `ض ح ك:B003/m01`; insolence `ف ك ه:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Wit and laughter form a shared entertainment scene whose social polarity changes when wonder gives way to ridicule, backbiting, or insolence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Desire allocates attention toward enjoyment or away from obligation, producing delight, play, neglect, or abandonment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 80:10 names distraction, while 80:31-32 names fruit and enjoyment and 80:39 depicts delighted faces.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Pleasure reaches witty talk, sexuality, luxury, mockery, respite, and the complete abandonment of a concern.

parent_channels.name: Naming, Group Identity, and Place

subchannels.name: Tribal and Clan Names
subchannels.scene_or_process: A descent group is fixed and recognized through a conventional name.
subchannels.active_motifs: tribal name `ع ب س:B005/m01`; clan name `ن ب ت:B004/m01`; clan affiliation `ف ر ر:B014/m01`; lineage `ب ن ي:B007/m01`; community `ء م م:B004/m01`; collateral kin `ك ل ل:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Descent and collateral relation supply the social body, while the tribal or clan name gives that body a stable public identity.

subchannels.name: Named Places, Valleys, and Settlements
subchannels.scene_or_process: A terrain feature or inhabited site acquires a fixed place-name.
subchannels.active_motifs: named place `ن خ ل:B006/m01`; place-name `ي س ر:B010/m01`; named valley or location `ق ض ب:B011/m01`; hill or place `ع ن ب:B004/m01`; remote village `ك ف ر:B012/m01`; residence `غ ن ي:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Hill, valley, village, and residence become spatial identities when conventional naming fixes otherwise descriptive terrain.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Names stabilize identity by attaching persons and groups to descent or locations to bounded terrain.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the surah's kin terms and named human collectives provide surface anchors for latent clan names, place names, and settlement identities.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Plant, bird, terrain, and personal lexemes become labels for tribes, valleys, and settlements.

parent_channels.name: Tracking, Riding, and Avian Life

subchannels.name: Stalking, Hunting, and Prey Verification
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hunter conceals approach, uses a blind and implement, strikes prey, and verifies death.
subchannels.active_motifs: concealing oneself to stalk prey `د ر ي:B003/m01`; hunting blind `ق ت ر:B002/m01`; hunting implement `ط ع م:B006/m01`; small arrows `ق ت ر:B006/m01`; exposing prey to death `ق ت ل:B005/m01`; verifying that prey has died `م و ت:B014/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Concealment and the hunting blind enable approach, the implement and arrow produce the strike, and inspection of the prey completes the hunt.

subchannels.name: Mounted Pursuit and Fitted Tack
subchannels.scene_or_process: A horse is equipped for controlled, rapid travel or competitive pursuit.
subchannels.active_motifs: horse muzzle and gallop `ط ع م:B009/m01`; light responsive gait `ي س ر:B005/m01`; fitted saddle `ق ت ر:B008/m01`; saddle underlay `و ل ي:B011/m01`; accelerated travel `ر ف ع:B003/m01`; racing and overcoming `س ع ي:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Muzzle, saddle, and underlay fit rider to mount, while responsive gait and accelerated racing supply the movement outcome.

subchannels.name: Owls, Larks, Ostriches, and Bird Calls
subchannels.scene_or_process: Distinct birds occupy a shared avian scene differentiated by size, species, and call.
subchannels.active_motifs: male owl `ص د ي:B001/m01`; lark `ق ب ر:B003/m01`; small bird `ف ر ر:B011/m01`; ostrich `ن ع م:B006/m01`; bird call `ش ق ق:B008/m03`; animal cry `ض ح ك:B011/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Owl, lark, small bird, and ostrich form a concrete species inventory, while calls and cries make their presence acoustically detectable.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Animal movement becomes legible through pursuit, equipment, gait, calls, and species-specific form.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 80:32 names livestock, while roots elsewhere in the surah open latent scenes of hunting, riding, and bird life.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The animal network assembles hunting blinds, prey verification, fitted saddles, owl calls, larks, ostriches, and small birds.

parent_channels.name: Terrain, Wayfinding, and Habitation

subchannels.name: Lowland, Slope, Gap, and Trackless Ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler confronts terrain differentiated by elevation, opening, and navigability.
subchannels.active_motifs: low ground `ء ر ض:B001/m01`; slope or declivity `ص ب ب:B002/m01`; sandy gap with plants `ش ق ق:B007/m01`; trackless land `ع م ي:B006/m01`; hill or rise `ع ن ب:B004/m01`; valley or wadi `ق ض ب:B011/m01`; basin depression `ج ي ء:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Basin, lowland, slope, hill, valley, sandy opening, and trackless expanse define the changing physical constraints of traversable ground.

subchannels.name: Road Sign, Clear Course, and Mountain Pass
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler selects direction by reading a marked route through obstructing terrain.
subchannels.active_motifs: road marker or sign `ء م ر:B005/m01`; clear road `ض ح ك:B005/m01`; mountain pass or wall `ك ف ر:B013/m01`; direction and course `و ج ه:B002/m01`; road `س ب ل:B001/m01`; far distance `ش ق ق:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Sign, direction, and clear course orient the traveler, while distance, wall, and mountain pass define the obstacles the route must negotiate.

subchannels.name: Settlement, Residence, and Agreeable Place
subchannels.scene_or_process: Movement ends in a bounded place that supports dwelling and social continuity.
subchannels.active_motifs: remote village or settlement `ك ف ر:B012/m01`; residence `غ ن ي:B004/m01`; agreeable place of stay `ن ع م:B011/m01`; sacred building or Meccan locus `ب ن ي:B003/m01`; remaining fixed to place `ء ر ض:B006/m01`; neighboring dwellings `ن ظ ر:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Fixed residence, neighboring dwellings, village, and sacred locus convert traversed terrain into a socially inhabited place.

subchannels.name: Building, Pillar, Shelter, and Enclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Materials are raised and bounded to support, cover, and protect an inhabited interior.
subchannels.active_motifs: building `ب ن ي:B001/m01`; pillars or structural supports `ب ن ي:B009/m01`; leather shelter `ب ن ي:B004/m01`; surrounding enclosure `ح د ق:B001/m01`; protective screen `ك ل ل:B006/m01`; excavated well or hollow `خ ل ق:B011/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Supports establish the frame, covering and screen protect it, enclosure marks its perimeter, and the well supplies a functional interior cavity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Uneven land is traversed by signs and paths, then bounded and built into places of residence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 80:20 supplies the path, 80:26 the earth, and 80:30 the enclosed gardens from which the latent terrain and habitation system expands.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Low ground, trackless steppe, sandy gaps, mountain passes, road signs, villages, leather shelters, and structural pillars form one spatial progression.

parent_channels.name: S1. Diminutive Forms and Offshoots
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Smallness recurs across bodies, young animals, plant shoots, paths, projectiles, and quantities.
parent_channels.active_motifs: insignificant or small entity `ء م م:B013/m01`; compact short body `ح ب ب:B010/m01`; little quantity `ي س ر:B002/m01`; young lamb `ء م ر:B009/m01`; minor branch roads `ب ن ي:B008/m01`; small palm shoot `ش ي ء:B006/m01`; small bird `ف ر ر:B011/m01`; small arrows `ق ت ر:B006/m01`; small snake `ق ت ر:B009/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Diminution is not one object class but one scale relation, linking offspring, offshoot, side-path, projectile, creature, body shape, and small amount.

parent_channels.name: S2. Lots and the Apportioned Carcass
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Participants cast marked arrows for stakes and divide a slaughtered animal according to the resulting lots.
parent_channels.active_motifs: gambling by arrows and division of a camel carcass `ي س ر:B007/m01`; small arrows `ق ت ر:B006/m01`; measured portions `ق د ر:B006/m01`; cutting into shares `ق ض ب:B001/m01`; livestock wealth `ن ع م:B005/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Arrow, animal, cut, and measured share form a complete distributive game in which chance assigns portions of a common carcass.

parent_channels.name: S3. Healing Incantation and Protective Treatment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A vulnerable body is cleansed, anointed, or addressed by a curative formula after injury or pallor.
parent_channels.active_motifs: healing incantation `ن ش ر:B008/m01`; purifying water or implement `ط ه ر:B004/m01`; oiling `ز ي ت:B003/m01`; medicinal coating or perfuming `خ ل ق:B010/m01`; pallor or harmful glance `ن ظ ر:B007/m01`; wound approaching the brain `ن ط ف:B005/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The treatment scene combines bodily vulnerability with cleansing, oil or coating, and a spoken curative act intended to restore the patient.
